Game Overview

At its heart, Tung Tung Sahur at Backrooms is a escape game about navigate the unnerving Backrooms as Ballerina Cappucina, pirouetting through a nightmare in search of magical noodles. Dance gracefully while evading the relentless Tung Tung Sahur, whose rhythmic drumbeats close in ever faster. Can you collect them all and return to reality before his ominous "TUNG TUNG" find you?
